title: Admin status labels
summary: Admin module, plugin, user and group status labels now come from lang keys in Title Case.
changes: Plugin code status reads Shipped, Code Not Shipped or Incompatible from lang, matching the Admin overview alerts.
Admin Plugins and Modules show Enabled, Disabled, Available and the Install, Enable and Disable actions from lang.
Admin user and group screens show Active, Suspended, Present and Missing from lang instead of hard-coded text.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: Admin display labels only, with no behaviour or permission change.
validation: AdminStatusLabelsTest covers lang-backed code status, actions, states and the absence of hard-coded Admin status chrome.
Module administration and Admin analytics tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
